name: Ouka Ryouran
source:
After the era of Warring States peace was reinstalled. But there are still people who plan revenge. Shogunate establishes "special police office" to hold warriors with great authority and mobility to crack down on vicious bandits. The story begins after protagonist gets appointed to this unit as new enforcer.

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2020/07/vn-of-month-march-2008-12riven-climinal.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
战国时代结束后，和平重新降临，但仍有人企图复仇。幕府设立「特别警察厅」，赋予武士极大的权力和机动性，以打击凶恶匪徒。故事从主人公被任命为该单位的新执法者后开始。

[摘自[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2020/07/vn-of-month-march-2008-12riven-climinal.html]vndbreview[/url]]
